description: This Python script implements a custom linter for Bazel build files, specifically checking for redundant SHA256 checksums in http_archive rules. It parses Bazel's XML output to identify disallowed checksums and reports issues accordingly.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enumeration for severity levels of lint messages (error, warning, advice, disabled).

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: NamedTuple representing a lint message with details such as path, line, code, severity, description, etc.

methods.name: is_required_checksum
methods.description: Determines if a list of URLs requires a checksum based on their domain.

methods.name: get_disallowed_checksums
methods.description: Uses Bazel to query external dependencies and returns a set of checksums that are disallowed based on their URLs.

methods.name: check_bazel
methods.description: Reads a file, detects SHA256 checksums, and reports if any are disallowed, suggesting to run a fix.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that parses arguments, retrieves disallowed checksums, and runs the linter on provided files.
